title: Notifications
description: Learn how to manage push notifications and browser alerts to stay informed while controlling which websites can send you notifications.
content:
Browser notifications help you stay updated with important information from websites you visit. You can control which sites can send you notifications and customize how you receive them.

Oasis Feature

Oasis includes notification management built on Firefox core technology. This feature helps you stay informed while maintaining control over which websites can send you notifications.

What are Browser Notifications?

Browser notifications are alerts that websites can send to your device, even when you're not actively using the browser. They can include updates, messages, reminders, and other important information.

Types of Notifications

  • Push notifications from websites
  • System notifications
  • Alert notifications
  • Permission requests
  • Browser updates and alerts

Common Use Cases

  • Social media updates
  • Email notifications
  • News and weather alerts
  • Shopping and deal notifications
  • Calendar and reminder alerts

Managing Notification Permissions

Follow these steps to control which websites can send you notifications:

1

Access Notification Settings

Open your browser settings and navigate to Privacy & Security. Look for "Permissions" or "Notifications" to manage notification preferences.

2

Set Default Behavior

Choose whether to allow, block, or ask for permission when websites request notification access. You can set different defaults for different types of sites.

3

Manage Individual Sites

Review and modify notification permissions for specific websites. You can allow, block, or remove permissions for individual sites.

4

Test Your Settings

Visit websites that use notifications to test your settings and ensure they're working as expected.

Notification Permission Options

Allow

  • Website can send you notifications
  • Notifications appear even when browser is closed
  • You'll receive all notification types
  • Can be changed later in settings
  • Useful for important services

Block

  • Website cannot send notifications
  • No notification prompts will appear
  • Completely disables notification features
  • Can be changed later in settings
  • Good for privacy and focus

Ask

  • Browser will ask for permission each time
  • You decide on a case-by-case basis
  • Provides maximum control
  • Default setting for most browsers
  • Balances convenience and privacy

Receiving and Managing Notifications

1

Notification Display

When you receive a notification, it will appear as a popup or system notification depending on your operating system and browser settings.

2

Interaction Options

You can click on notifications to open the related website, dismiss them, or take other actions depending on the notification type.

3

Notification Center

Access your notification history and manage recent notifications through your browser's notification center or system notification panel.

Privacy and Security

Privacy Protection

  • You control which sites can send notifications
  • Notification content is visible to you only
  • No personal data is shared with notification services
  • You can revoke permissions at any time
  • Notifications don't track your browsing

Security Features

  • Notifications only from permitted sites
  • Secure notification delivery
  • No malicious notification injection
  • Easy permission management
  • Clear notification sources

Customizing Notification Settings

Display Preferences

  • Choose notification position on screen
  • Set notification duration
  • Configure sound alerts
  • Customize notification appearance
  • Set quiet hours for notifications

Content Controls

  • Filter notification types
  • Block specific notification content
  • Set priority levels for notifications
  • Configure notification grouping
  • Manage notification history

Common Notification Scenarios

Social Media

  • New message notifications
  • Friend request alerts
  • Post and comment updates
  • Event reminders
  • Live stream notifications

Email and Communication

  • New email alerts
  • Calendar event reminders
  • Meeting notifications
  • Chat message alerts
  • Voicemail notifications

News and Information

  • Breaking news alerts
  • Weather warnings
  • Traffic updates
  • Price drop notifications
  • Deal and coupon alerts

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

  • Notifications not appearing
  • Permission requests not showing
  • Notifications appearing when blocked
  • Too many notification prompts
  • Notifications from unknown sources

Solutions

  • Check notification settings and permissions
  • Verify system notification settings
  • Clear browser cache and cookies
  • Update browser to latest version
  • Check for conflicting extensions

Best Practices

Privacy Tips

  • Only allow notifications from trusted sites
  • Regularly review notification permissions
  • Block notifications from unknown sources
  • Use "Ask" permission for new sites
  • Clear notification history periodically

Productivity Tips

  • Set quiet hours for focus time
  • Group similar notifications
  • Use priority settings for important alerts
  • Customize notification sounds
  • Organize notification permissions by category

Advanced Features

Notification Management

  • Bulk permission management
  • Notification scheduling
  • Cross-device notification sync
  • Notification analytics and insights
  • Custom notification rules

Integration Features

  • Works with system notification center
  • Compatible with notification apps
  • Supports notification actions
  • Integrates with calendar and email
  • Works across different devices

What to Expect

When using browser notifications, you may experience:

Convenience Benefits

  • Stay updated without checking websites
  • Receive important alerts immediately
  • Never miss important messages
  • Efficient information delivery
  • Reduced manual checking

Considerations

  • May receive unwanted notifications
  • Requires permission management
  • Can be distracting if not managed
  • May need to adjust settings over time
  • Should be used selectively

Getting Help

For detailed instructions on managing push notifications and browser alerts, visit Mozilla's official support guide:

Mozilla Push Notifications Guide

Technical Details

Browser notifications use advanced web technologies to deliver timely information:

How Notifications Work

  • Push API: Enables websites to send notifications even when the browser is closed
  • Service Workers: Handle notification delivery and management in the background
  • Permission System: Controls which websites can send notifications
  • Secure Delivery: Ensures notifications are delivered safely and privately
  • Cross-Platform: Works across different operating systems and devices

Since Oasis is built on Firefox core technology, notification functionality provides the same reliable and secure notification capabilities with enhanced privacy controls.
